# Lab 8.8: Dataform CLI Locally

## What We Are Going to Do
Install the open-source Dataform CLI in Cloud Shell, compile the project, and run it from the command line.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Install the CLI and clone your repo.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">npm install -g @dataform/cli
dataform --version
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USER/bq-course-dataform.git
cd bq-course-dataform</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create credentials.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">dataform init-creds</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Choose **US** as the location and **Application Default Credentials**. This creates `.df-credentials.json`. Add it to `.gitignore`.

3. **[CLI] Compile and inspect.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">dataform compile
dataform compile --json | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print([t['target']['name'] for t in d.get('tables',[])])"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Dry run, then run.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">dataform run --dry-run
dataform run --actions orders_by_country --include-deps</span>
</code></pre>

5. **[Console] See the CLI jobs.** In BigQuery **Personal history**, the jobs from the CLI run appear.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Dataform core | Open source, same as the console |
| `compile` | Builds the graph locally |
| `run --dry-run` | Validates SQL without running it |
| Credentials | `.df-credentials.json`, never committed |
